tools.name: list_models
tools.description: List the sample supply chain models run_simulation has a saved engine run for, with each model's id and a short description.

tools.name: run_simulation
tools.description: Return the saved SC Builder engine run of a sample supply chain model: metrics, orders, shipments, routing and inventory series, verbatim. This server runs no engine; a model without a saved run answers 'not available here'. Quote the numbers verbatim.

tools.name: get_sc_theory
tools.description: Reference text from the SC Builder engine: event-driven model, ordering policies (pull, push, planned), the forecast-demand and order-point formulas, bill of materials, routing and supplier selection. Static text.

tools.name: explain_simulation
tools.description: Primer on supply chain simulation: when to simulate, optimize or both, how a discrete-event network model works, which numbers the engine reports, and the limits of a single run. Static text; call run_simulation for figures.

tools.name: explain_optimization
tools.description: Primer on supply chain network optimization: mixed-integer programming, decision variables and constraints, landed-cost objectives, the common problem classes, and when to optimize versus simulate. Static text.

tools.name: explain_greenfield
tools.description: Primer on greenfield analysis: center-of-gravity (Weber) siting, Weiszfeld's algorithm, location-allocation for N facilities, service constraints, and when to use greenfield versus facility selection. Static text.

tools.name: list_opt_demos
tools.description: List the saved optimization demos (Tariff sourcing, Coffee co-pack siting, Safety Stock Optimization) with an id and summary each. Use before describe_opt_demo or get_opt_result.

tools.name: describe_opt_demo
tools.description: Detail on one optimization demo: what it shows, its source, and every saved scenario key. Use before get_opt_result.

tools.name: get_opt_result
tools.description: Return the saved optimization result for one scenario of a demo, verbatim: sourcing, production and transport decisions, costs, and facility open/close decisions. Call describe_opt_demo first for the valid scenario keys. Quote the numbers verbatim.

tools.name: list_greenfield_demos
tools.description: List the saved greenfield siting demos with an id and summary each. Use before describe_greenfield_demo or get_greenfield_result.

tools.name: describe_greenfield_demo
tools.description: Detail on one greenfield demo: region, customer count, the saved DC counts and the score curve. Use before get_greenfield_result.

tools.name: get_greenfield_result
tools.description: Return the saved greenfield result for one DC count, verbatim: the sited DCs (lat/lon, nearest city) and which customers each serves. Quote the numbers verbatim.
